description: Mutation sweep over supersede_stages, the machinery that retires stages so they can be re-run. Swept rather than trusted because it moves the only copy of evidence from a collection that cannot be repeated, inside a directory both agent seats were otherwise forbidden to write to, and because the first plan every party agreed to -- supersede stage 1 and stage 4, keep 2 and 3 -- is one this function must REFUSE. Its most important guard is a refusal against its own operators.

a live supervisor no longer blocks the move

an unexplained supersede is allowed

an artifact outside the work directory is moved
containment is checked textually, so a relative escape passes
a missing artifact is recorded as moved
a second supersede overwrites an existing archive
a quarantine is cleared without anybody asking
the cleared quarantine is not recorded, so the reason for the stop is lost
the receipt is deleted rather than archived
